opus.w: This is the standard opening clause of an appropriations act. It only states that sums are appropriated from the Treasury for fiscal year 1948. It does not involve any party outside the federal government in any federal decision. Generic wording like "for other purposes" does not count as participation because it sets up no consultation, hearing or advisory process.
opus.b:
1. **Tempting wrong reading:** None, really. The only possible hook is the word "purposes" in "for other purposes." But this is just the opening line of an appropriations act. It involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body or right to sue. Nobody outside the federal government is involved in any decision.
